title: Incorrect logical operator in stop()
detail: The original logic printed a blank line only when the console was both non-interactive and not in Jupyter. The new code uses `or`, causing a blank line to be printed when either condition is true, which can produce unwanted output when the console is interactive but not Jupyter, or vice versa.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. This condition always evaluates to True, causing the lock acquisition logic to misbehave.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: Calling `acquire()` without awaiting returns a Deferred that is never awaited, potentially blocking the event loop and causing deadlocks.
note: Says the lock is acquired without being awaited.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is present in the Accept header, but the code returns True when it is absent, causing incorrect behavior.
